# Psalm 15 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 15:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** His-money he-does-not give at-interest, and-a-bribe against the-innocent he-does-not take. The-one-doing these [things] shall-never be-moved.
- **LOGOS:** who does not put out his money at interest and does not take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
- **PNEUMA:** Those who lend money without charging interest and who cannot be bribed to lie about the innocent. Such people will stand firm forever.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** Those who reject what is vile and honor the faithful followers of the LORD. Those who keep their promises even when it costs them.
